2607.09287.title: Super-Tuning: From Activation-Aware Pruning to Sparse Fine-Tuning
2607.09287.paper_summary: Large language models (LLMs) remain expensive to fine-tune because full-parameter updates require substantial memory, compute, and per-task storage. We study whether saliency signals originally developed for pruning can be reused to choose where a model should adapt. We propose Super, a sparse parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) method that fixes a small trainable support using a Wanda-style activation-weighted magnitude score [Sun et al., 2023] computed from a calibration pass. We then introduce Supra, a hybrid adapter that combines this sparse update with LoRA while preserving a matched trainable-parameter budget through a simple budget-splitting rule. In single-seed Math17K arithmetic experiments on Llama-3.2-1B and Meta-Llama-3-8B, the best Super/Supra variants achieve the highest average accuracy among the tested schedule-selected adapter configurations. We also include a PaFi-style magnitude-only support as a closest training-free sparse baseline and find that low-score supports under both magnitude and Wanda-style orderings can be effective. These results suggest that simple pruning-inspired orderings can provide useful fixed sparse supports for PEFT, especially when combined with low-rank adapters.
2607.09287.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）的微調仍然昂貴，因為全參數更新需要大量的記憶體、計算資源和每個任務的儲存空間。我們研究了最初為修剪而開發的顯著性信號是否可以重用，以選擇模型應該適應的位置。我們提出了Super，一種稀疏參數高效微調（PEFT）方法，使用從校準過程中計算出的Wanda風格的激活加權幅度分數[Sun et al., 2023]來固定一小部分可訓練的支持。我們接著介紹了Supra，一種混合適配器，將這種稀疏更新與LoRA結合，同時通過簡單的預算拆分規則保持匹配的可訓練參數預算。在Llama-3.2-1B和Meta-Llama-3-8B的單種子Math17K算術實驗中，最佳的Super/Supra變體在測試的計劃選擇適配器配置中實現了最高的平均準確率。我們還包括了一個PaFi風格的僅幅度支持作為最接近的無訓練稀疏基線，並發現低分支持在幅度和Wanda風格排序下都可以有效。這些結果表明，簡單的受修剪啟發的排序可以為PEFT提供有用的固定稀疏支持，特別是當與低秩適配器結合時。
